'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Justin Desai LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Deck name '''KToD'''. Sheet line 1 '''Coruscant Nightclub (V)''' (starting site); objective '''It Is The Future You See (V)''' on sheet. Dest note: prior hub row said TIGIH — corrected to IITFYS.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|It Is The Future You See (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
